before: Repeat Header Rows and table alignment and width were refused in every editing mode.
after: They write w:trPr/w:tblHeader, w:tblPr/w:jc and w:tblPr/w:tblW. In suggesting mode they write w:trPrChange or w:tblPrChange with w:tcPrChange on the affected cells, under one revision per gesture.
